mapper.sql: id, category_id, name, image_url, description, price, status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (category_id, name, image_url, description, price, status) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, #{status}DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM products ORDER BY id

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.image_url, p.description, p.price, p.status FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.category_id, p.id
SELECT FROM products WHERE id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId})
SELECT FROM products WHERE id IN (SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.pickup_date = #{pickupDate} AND o.order_type = 'TAKEAWAY')
